blurb:
Led by the most experienced local guides, your all-inclusive walking tour will provide fascinating insights into the history of Niagara. Descend 120 feet down and Journey Behind the Falls, then embark on an unforgettable Niagara City cruise boat ride through the Niagara River up to Niagara Falls.

Morning are Best: beat the heat, avoid the crowds, and free up the rest of your day

The perfect Niagara Falls, Canada Experience for those wanting the Top 3 Attractions (Boat, Journey, Falls) with Skip the ticket lines access.

• During this intermittent walking tour, you will be traveling approx. 1.5 miles spread out over our 2.5 hours together. Lots of stops, not overwhelming

• Get spectacular views of all 3 falls (Canadian Horseshoe, American and Bridal) along with Queen Victoria Park

• Feel the thunderous vibrations of the Falls as you descend 120 and Journey behind the Falls

• Feel the mist on your face with a thrilling Niagara City boat ride up the Niagara River into the Waterfalls.
